annotations.title: List what a record is linked to

description: AI Agents: Use to see what one record is linked to inside an AI agent's system, such as the deals of a contact or the notes of a deal. Ids it returns are read with read_activities or read_conversation. Not for other systems (use find_linked_records).

cursor.description: The cursor of the previous answer, to read the next page.

id.description: The id of that record in the system.

limit.description: How many to return per page, 1 to 100.

related.description: What to list: a record type, or an activity, a conversation, a side conversation, a line item, a payment, a document or its business (company).

system.description: The AI agent's system or connection name.

type.description: The type of the record whose links to list: a record type, or a business (a company).

name: list_related_records
title: List what a record is linked to
